summary: Iteration 7 full verification of minimalist redesign + frontend info-disclosure security fix. Backend: 22/22 pytest passing (12 core + 10 security, excluding rate-limit burn test to preserve bucket for UI tests). All security headers still present, secret safety confirmed (no sk-), en/fr/es/de/ja mint ek_ + audio.output.language matches; invalid target -> 400. Frontend: minimalist Console renders with fixed 'Auto-detect' Source card and TARGET-only combobox (13 options with native names Español/日本語/Français etc). All required data-testids present (target-language-select, target-language-select-search, audio-device-select, audio-level-meter, test-input-button, start-translation-button, mute-input/mute-translation/restart-translation/settings buttons, 4 status dots, session-timer-display, latency-display, both transcript panels/texts, fullscreen-transcript-button). No legacy direction-fr-en/direction-en-fr toggles. Search 'spa' -> Spanish filters to 1; label becomes 'TRANSLATION — SPANISH'. Search 'jap' -> Japanese label 'TRANSLATION — JAPANESE'. Selecting target=German + START posts exactly one POST to /api/realtime-session with body target_language='de'. SECURITY FIX VERIFIED: after the OpenAI /calls 429, the error-banner shows GENERIC 'The translation service is temporarily unavailable (quota limit reached). Please try again later.' — no 'insufficient_quota', no billing URL, no raw OpenAI JSON; START button restored (no crash). Settings dialog opens with all mode-*/profile-*/save-transcripts-toggle/export-txt-button/export-pdf-button testids; mode-custom reveals custom-instructions-input; save-transcripts-toggle defaults unchecked visually. Sermon mode + Event 'Sunday Service' + biblical vocab 'Holy Spirit' + target=English -> POST instructions is non-empty and contains 'Sunday Service', 'Holy Spirit', 'biblical', and 'into English'. TEST INPUT: 0 /api/realtime-session POSTs during metering; stop-test-input-button appears and stopping restores test-input-button. Fullscreen overlay opens and exit closes it. /debug loads, tabs (logs, events) click, no 'sk-' anywhere in DOM.

issues: Small i18n inconsistency: card shows '70+ langues' (French) in the top-right subtext while the rest of the UI is English. Consider '70+ languages' for consistency.

action_items: Minor: unify '70+ langues' -> '70+ languages' in Console.jsx Source card (design consistency).

Minor testability: [data-testid=save-transcripts-toggle] is on the <label>, not the <input>; consider putting the testid on the input so aria/checked can be introspected directly (functionality is fine).
critical_code_review_comments: translationEngine.js _connect() correctly drops the raw OpenAI /calls response body from the propagated Error (throws 'OPENAI_CONNECT:<status>:' with no detail); raw body only reaches console.error. TranslationContext.mapError() converts 429 to the required generic string. Info-disclosure gap from iter_6 is closed.

Compiled instructions include the target-language name via profiles.compileInstructions({targetName}), and TranslationContext.start() resolves targetName from getTarget(targetLang).name — matches new spec.
Backend rate limit is per-process in-memory (20/60s); still fine for this preview but note for scale.
LanguageCombobox correctly exposes both a stable trigger testid and a search-input testid ('<testId>-search'), and encodes name|native|code in the CommandItem value so search matches on all three.

success_rate.backend: 100% (22/22 pytest; rate-limit test skipped intentionally to preserve bucket)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression + security suites live at /app/backend/tests/test_translatebox.py and /app/backend/tests/test_security_hardening.py. Always export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env before pytest. Backend rate limit is 20/60s per IP; test_zzz_rate_limit_triggers_429 (in security file) consumes the bucket and sleeps 65s — run it LAST or skip when combining with UI tests, otherwise concurrent START flows in the UI will hit 429 before reaching /calls. The frontend info-disclosure fix now lives in /app/frontend/src/lib/translationEngine.js (raw /calls body kept out of Error) + TranslationContext.mapError() (generic 429 message). If the OpenAI org gets credits, the /calls 429 will disappear and START should reach 'connected' — retest full transcript flow then.
rca of the issue: N/A — all reported issues from prior iterations are now resolved.
